phase3_gate_reason: route_A (window-local leaf on the existing rank tiles): authentic lane mass with window <= 1024 slots = 4.65403855e-07, <= 4096 slots = 7.890447295e-05 against a 0.10 threshold; median window = 18745 slots -> NOT VIABLE. route_B (value retiling): the configuration with the fewest tiles is Bx=16 Bq=16 at 649189 tiles (0.06563853464x rank), but it issues 613614944 rectangle tests for 620966064 source pairs -- 1.011980021 pairs per test, i.e. the original pairwise scan under another name. Charging every rectangle at the floor cost of one pair probe, the best routing-inclusive ceiling over all 19 configurations is Bx=65536 Bq=65536 at 12.53655586x, versus 14.30075326x for the UNCHANGED rank tiling at the same measured K3 cost class and the 4.4415x needed to materially beat the previous 2.961x -> NOT VIABLE.
